positive_assertions: Real renderer/IPC/core/main SDK/loopback HTTP authentication, without fake returned auth state.
Sixth case delays completed original IPC GET replies; original handler still executes and returns unchanged response bytes.
Six digits alone do not submit; doubled Continue produces one new verification request.
Refused email/code retains editable inputs; accepted auth survives renderer reload, not process restart.
Origin/mode changes and Cancel reject late held verification replies and clear candidate state.
Known fixture token/cookie/pending/challenge/QR/TOTP/error markers absent from IPC response, DOM, browser stores and inspected engine files.
No renderer-originated HTTP calls; next identity requests carry no previous bearer/cookie.
Registry asserts every visited state has correct theme/nonempty text, no raw translation keys and no accumulated page errors.
visual_observations: Refusal, signed-in, unsupported-continuation and Settings controls readable at 960x640 in tested themes; one signed-in capture 1440x900 light.
Initial-read cancel image is vertically scrolled: top brand mark clipped, email and Cancel visible. Existing bounded visual limitation, not full visual acceptance.
Settings subtitle ellipsizes at narrow width; focused long URL horizontally scrolls.
MFA and email-verification captures intentionally identical within each theme.
qualifications: Full report has zero test/report errors; native transition regression deliberately collects three callback errors. Do not claim zero runtime errors throughout all 90 cases.
Prior read-races/report.json is a zero-test selector failure. read-races/result.json is the successful single-case run.
Screens sweep is 426 renders, not 426 reviewed screenshots or pixel approval.
Full suite has six auth cases; first-electron five-case evidence is a prior run, not five additional cases.
Controlled loopback backend establishes local SDK/IPC behavior, not deployed Cloud authentication or remote inference.
Existing installed b0e6d78 preview-departure and terminal-overflow failures remain valid negative evidence; that package excludes auth delta.
Current auth build/source pins do not attest later preview/terminal fixes, future CI or native auth acceptance.
